model.cutoff_source: Meta Llama 3.1 model card, 'Data Freshness: The pretraining data has a cutoff of December 2023' (https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct). Read in the build session only through third-party copies of the card (search results, 2026-10-22); the owner should check the official page.

Not documented: the official Qwen2.5-Coder model card (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct) was not reachable from the build session, and third-party listings (e.g. OpenRouter: 'Jun 2024') are not the publisher. Treated as undocumented, so every case counts as possibly seen.
